title: Operation serves Applicationfunction
description: An API operation serves an application function that calls it as a client.
x-dr-evidence: fetch('/api/v1/items'), axios.post(...), a generated SDK call (ItemsService.createItem) or a gRPC or GraphQL client call inside a function, resolved by CBM to the operation's route; CBM HTTP_CALLS, GRPC_CALLS, GRAPHQL_CALLS or TRPC_CALLS.
